DeployBot: STAGING deploy STARTED • env=staging • commit=8a4c2b3 (release/rc5) • tag=rc5-20260320 • initiator=@Carla • change window=2026-03-20T18:00-20:00Z • plan=canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% • details: https://ci.internal/build/12345

Carla: Kicking off smoke suite now, running runtime + reranker smoke. I’ll monitor latency and errors. @Infra-QA please shout if anything turns red.

Infra-QA: Smoke tests started: `./test/smoke --env=staging --suite=runtime,reranker` — ETA ~6m. Will post summary.

Matt: Tagging commit and prepping rollback playbook. Rollback trigger: p50 > 200ms OR 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m.

DeployBot: Smoke result: 14/14 tests PASSED. Proceeding to canary traffic shift -> 10%.

Sara: Observability configured: alerts for token_errors and 5xx at stricter thresholds for the canary. Watching logs and trace samples.

DeployBot: Canary shift to 10% complete. Metrics snapshot: 2xx=99.6% • p50=98ms • p95=320ms. @ReleaseManager to continue to 50%?

ReleaseManager: Approved to proceed to 50%. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Shifting traffic to 50% and running healthgates.

Infra-QA: HEALTHGATE ALERT at 2026-03-20T18:27Z — reranker errors spike observed, sample log:
```
ERROR RerankerV3 - KV cache miss overflow - key_len=4096 - mempool=exhausted
```
Suggest pinning reranker to stable-rc4 for runtime route while we investigate.

Matt: Acknowledged. Preparing pin rollback for reranker variant. Command to apply: 
```
redwood deploy rollback --service=runtimes --component=reranker --to=stable-rc4
```
Executing now.

DeployBot: Reranker pinned to `stable-rc4` on runtimes service. Canary metrics updating — p95 improved to 180ms, error rate trending back to baseline. Rolling forward paused for 4m for observation.

Sara: Adding a note for release: "Temporary reranker pin due to KV cache overflow under canary load; root-cause investigation in progress."

Carla: Metrics stable for 10m post-pin. I give the ✅ to finish the staging rollout. Tagging final release as `rc5-deployed-20260320`.

DeployBot: STAGING deploy COMPLETE • commit=8a4c2b3 • tag=rc5-deployed-20260320 • duration=22m • notes="reranker pinned to stable-rc4 during rollout; follow-up investigation scheduled" • changelog: https://release.internal/notes/rc5-20260320

Matt: I'll open an issue for the reranker KV cache fix and schedule a hotfix branch. Assigning to @Matt and @Infra-QA.

Carla: Thanks team — good catch and quick response. I’ll start prod rollout checklist tomorrow in the next change window. :rocket:
